note: Blaine County OK publishes no zoning districts layer; its GIS maps are static PDFs (precincts, commissioner districts). Watonga lists a 'Zoning Map 2022' on its site, apparently a static document, and Geary's zoning is only in ordinance text (Municode/cityofgeary.com). No queryable ArcGIS zoning polygon layer for the county or its cities was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches; Regrid holds commercial parcel zoning only, not official.
